positive_definition: At least part of one or more dunes was identified within a0.1degree cell. No morphology class.
zero_definition: Unrecorded; not verified absence. Some regions not assessed and coastal cells excluded.
training_use: Positive-unlabeled regional evidence only. Do not train a supervised negative class from zeros or label each image pixel as sand.
cross_planet_limit: Not equivalent to DoMars image-level aeolian class or a cross-planet relevance label.
